author: The Infographics Show
description:
Everyone’s obsessed with Ozempic, but a far stranger trend is exploding underground.
Teens and tech elites are injecting unregulated “magic peptides” to hack their bodies.

In this episode, we uncover the hidden world of biohacking injections like BPC-157, the so-called “Wolverine peptide”, and how they went from Cold War experiments to a global gray-market phenomenon.
From Soviet scientist Vladimir Khavinson to modern Silicon Valley circles, these compounds promise faster healing, anti-aging, and even cognitive upgrades.
But the reality is far more complicated.

We dive into the rise of underground peptide markets, fueled by demand from online communities, fitness culture, and tech insiders.
With limited oversight from agencies like the FDA, users are turning to overseas suppliers, injecting substances that may be mislabeled, contaminated, or completely untested in humans.

title: Why Everyone Is Injecting This "MAGIC JUICE"
